evidence: The ALD cycle consists of three pulses: 5 s MeCpPtMe3 precursor dosing (A), 2 s O2 plasma exposure (B), and 2 s H2 gas (C) or 2 s H2 plasma (C*) exposure. The MeCpPtMe3 was heated to 30 °C and dosed into the deposition chamber by using Ar as carrier gas. An Ar purge step and a pump step (3 s each) directly after the MeCpPtMe3 pulse ensured that the reaction products and excessive precursor were evacuated from the chamber before pulsing the reactant.
